message:
VAT is now 25% instead of 20%, and the test suite passes (2 of 2).

The rate appeared in only two places, so I changed those and nothing else:

- **`src/vat.js`**: the multiplier is now `1.25` (was `1.2`), and the comment says 25%.
- **`test/vat.test.js`**: the expected values are updated to match. 1000 becomes 1250, and 250 becomes 313 because 250 × 1.25 = 312.5, which rounds to 313. 999 becomes 1249.

The repo has no README or other docs that mention the rate, so there was nothing else to update. I haven't committed the changes.

claims.sentence: VAT is now 25% instead of 20%, and the test suite passes (2 of 2).
- **`test/vat.test.js`**: the expected values are updated to match.
